req.title: Accept comma-separated status codes
req.statement: The system shall select one code at random when /status/<code> is called with a comma-separated list.

doc.reasoning: The requirement states that GET /status/<codes> with a comma-separated list shall select one code at random. The source code in view_status_code splits on ',' and calls weighted_choice then status_code(code). Tests must: (1) verify that a valid comma-separated list returns one of the listed codes (positive/EP), (2) verify that an invalid code in the list returns 400 (negative/NEG), (3) verify boundary of a single-element list with no comma (boundary/BVA — the comma-branch is NOT taken), (4) verify weighted syntax works (positive/DT), (5) verify that all codes in the list are reachable over many trials (mutation-resilient probabilistic coverage). Exact status code assertions are used throughout to kill constant-mutation and comparison-mutation operators.

tests.name: test_comma_separated_returns_one_of_listed_codes
preconditions: httpbin Flask app is importable in-process
actions: Assert response status_code is exactly one of {200, 301, 404}
expected: Response status code is exactly 200, 301, or 404
No other status code is returned
trace: R-HTTPBIN-016: system selects one code at random from comma-separated list
tests.executable:
from httpbin.core import app
client = app.test_client()

def test_comma_separated_returns_one_of_listed_codes():
    allowed = {200, 301, 404}
    r = client.get('/status/200,301,404', follow_redirects=False)
    assert r.status_code in allowed, f'Got {r.status_code}, expected one of {allowed}'
    assert r.status_code != 500
    assert r.status_code != 400

test_comma_separated_returns_one_of_listed_codes()

tests.name: test_comma_separated_all_codes_reachable_over_trials
preconditions: httpbin Flask app is importable in-process
actions: Collect set of observed status codes
Assert all three codes were observed at least once
expected: All three codes 200, 404, 500 appear in observed set after 200 trials
trace: R-HTTPBIN-016: random selection must be able to return each listed code
tests.executable:
from httpbin.core import app
client = app.test_client()

def test_comma_separated_all_codes_reachable_over_trials():
    allowed = {200, 404, 500}
    observed = set()
    for _ in range(200):
        r = client.get('/status/200,404,500', follow_redirects=False)
        assert r.status_code in allowed, f'Unexpected code {r.status_code}'
        observed.add(r.status_code)
    assert 200 in observed, 'Code 200 never returned'
    assert 404 in observed, 'Code 404 never returned'
    assert 500 in observed, 'Code 500 never returned'
    assert observed == allowed, f'Extra codes observed: {observed - allowed}'

test_comma_separated_all_codes_reachable_over_trials()

def test_two_code_comma_list_returns_only_those_two():
    allowed = {200, 500}
    observed = set()
    for _ in range(100):

preconditions: httpbin Flask app is importable in-process
actions: Assert response status_code is exactly 200 or 500
expected: Response status code is exactly 200 or 500
Weighted syntax is parsed without error

tests.executable:
from httpbin.core import app
client = app.test_client()

def test_weighted_comma_list_returns_valid_code():
    allowed = {200, 500}
    observed = set()
    for _ in range(60):
        r = client.get('/status/200:3,500:1', follow_redirects=False)
        assert r.status_code in allowed, f'Unexpected {r.status_code}'
        observed.add(r.status_code)
    assert 200 in observed, '200 never returned from weighted list'
    assert 500 in observed, '500 never returned from weighted list'

preconditions: httpbin Flask app is importable in-process
actions: Assert Location header is set to /redirect/1 for redirect codes
expected: Response status code is exactly 301 or 302
Location header equals '/redirect/1' for each response

tests.executable:
from httpbin.core import app
client = app.test_client()

def test_comma_list_with_redirect_code_sets_location_header():
    allowed = {301, 302}
    observed = set()
    for _ in range(60):
        r = client.get('/status/301,302', follow_redirects=False)
        assert r.status_code in allowed, f'Unexpected {r.status_code}'
        assert r.headers.get('Location') == '/redirect/1'
        observed.add(r.status_code)
    assert observed == {301, 302}, f'Not all redirect codes observed: {observed}'

test_comma_list_with_redirect_code_sets_location_header()
